<div id="rpg113Overlay" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Guilda de Caçadores">
 <div class="r113-shell">
  <div class="r113-head"><div><span class="r113-tag">SISTEMA DE PROGRESSÃO 11.3</span><h2>🏹 Guilda dos Caçadores do Abismo</h2><p class="r113-muted">Aceite contratos, complete objetivos durante sua jornada e receba recompensas integradas ao personagem.</p></div><button class="r113-close" onclick="RPG113.close()">Fechar ✕</button></div>
  <div id="r113Stats" class="r113-topstats"></div>
  <h3>📜 Contratos disponíveis</h3><div id="r113Board" class="r113-grid"></div>
  <h3>⚔️ Contratos em andamento</h3><div id="r113Active" class="r113-grid"></div>
  <h3>🏆 Contratos concluídos</h3><div id="r113Done" class="r113-card"></div>
 </div>
</div>
<script id="rpg113-guild-engine">
(()=>{
 const $=id=>document.getElementById(id), S=()=>typeof g!=='undefined'&&g?g:null;
 const templates=[
  {type:'hunt',title:'Controle de Ameaças',desc:'Derrote criaturas comuns na região atual.',target:5,xp:220,gold:180,rep:8},
  {type:'boss',title:'Queda de um Guardião',desc:'Derrote um chefe em qualquer mundo.',target:1,xp:650,gold:520,rep:25},
  {type:'travel',title:'Cartógrafo Errante',desc:'Explore novas regiões e amplie seus caminhos.',target:2,xp:300,gold:240,rep:12},
  {type:'wins',title:'Provação de Combate',desc:'Vença batalhas e prove sua consistência.',target:8,xp:420,gold:350,rep:16},
  {type:'explore',title:'Além das Trilhas',desc:'Realize explorações no mundo aberto.',target:6,xp:340,gold:280,rep:14},
  {type:'dungeon',title:'Ecos da Masmorra',desc:'Conclua uma expedição em uma dungeon.',target:2,xp:560,gold:440,rep:20}
 ];
 function init(){
  const s=S(); if(!s)return null;
  s.guild=s.guild||{active:[],done:0,claimed:[],board:[],serial:1,stats:{kills:0,bosses:0,travels:0,explores:0,dungeons:0}};
  const q=s.guild;q.active=q.active||[];q.claimed=q.claimed||[];q.board=q.board||[];q.stats=q.stats||{kills:0,bosses:0,travels:0,explores:0,dungeons:0};
  if(!q.board.length)rollBoard(q);
  return s;
 }
 function rollBoard(q){q.board=[];const pool=templates.slice().sort(()=>Math.random()-.5).slice(0,3);pool.forEach(t=>q.board.push({...t,id:'c'+(q.serial++),progress:0}))}
 function save(){try{if(typeof window.save==='function')window.save();}catch(e){}}
 function toast(t){if(typeof window.log==='function')window.log(t);else console.info(t)}
 function open(){if(!init()){toast('Inicie ou carregue uma jornada primeiro.');return}$('rpg113Overlay').classList.add('open');render()}
 function close(){$('rpg113Overlay').classList.remove('open')}
 function accept(id){const s=init(),q=s.guild;if(q.active.length>=3)return toast('Limite de 3 contratos ativos.');const i=q.board.findIndex(x=>x.id===id);if(i<0)return;const c=q.board.splice(i,1)[0];q.active.push(c);toast('Contrato aceito: '+c.title);save();render()}
 function update(type,n=1){const s=init();if(!s)return;const q=s.guild;const stat={hunt:'kills',boss:'bosses',travel:'travels',explore:'explores',dungeon:'dungeons',wins:'kills'}[type];if(stat)q.stats[stat]=(q.stats[stat]||0)+n;
  q.active.forEach(c=>{if(c.type===type||c.type==='wins'&&type==='hunt'){c.progress=Math.min(c.target,c.progress+n)}});
  save();
 }
 function claim(id){const s=init(),q=s.guild,c=q.active.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!c||c.progress<c.target)return;
  q.active=q.active.filter(x=>x.id!==id);q.done++;s.gold=(s.gold||0)+c.gold;s.rep=(s.rep||0)+c.rep;
  if(typeof window.gain==='function')window.gain(c.xp);else{s.xp=(s.xp||0)+c.xp}
  const reward={name:'Insígnia da Guilda: '+c.title,rarity:'Raro',level:s.level||1,price:0,atk:Math.max(1,Math.floor((s.level||1)*1.4)),def:Math.max(1,Math.floor((s.level||1)*.8)),hp:Math.floor((s.level||1)*2),mp:Math.floor((s.level||1)*1.5),slot:'relic',passive:'Recompensa de contrato'};
  s.inventory=s.inventory||[];s.inventory.push(reward);toast('Contrato concluído! +'+c.xp+' XP, +'+c.gold+' ouro, +'+c.rep+' reputação e uma insígnia.');save();render();if(typeof window.update==='function')window.update();
 }
 function card(c,active){const pct=Math.floor(100*c.progress/c.target);return `<div class="r113-card"><span class="r113-tag">${active?'EM ANDAMENTO':'CONTRATO DA GUILDA'}</span><h3>${c.title}</h3><p>${c.desc}</p><b>${c.progress}/${c.target}</b><div class="r113-progress"><span style="width:${pct}%"></span></div><small>🎁 ${c.xp} XP · ${c.gold} ouro · ${c.rep} reputação</small><br><button style="margin-top:10px" ${active?(c.progress<c.target?'disabled':''):''} onclick="RPG113.${active?'claim':'accept'}('${c.id}')">${active?(c.progress>=c.target?'Resgatar recompensa':'Objetivo em progresso'):'Aceitar contrato'}</button></div>`}
 function render(){const s=init();if(!s)return;const q=s.guild;$('r113Stats').innerHTML=`<div class="r113-stat"><b>${q.done}</b><small>Contratos concluídos</small></div><div class="r113-stat"><b>${q.active.length}/3</b><small>Contratos ativos</small></div><div class="r113-stat"><b>${s.rep||0}</b><small>Reputação atual</small></div>`;
  $('r113Board').innerHTML=q.board.length?q.board.map(c=>card(c,false)).join(''):'<div class="r113-card">Quadro vazio. Volte mais tarde para novos contratos.</div>';
  $('r113Active').innerHTML=q.active.length?q.active.map(c=>card(c,true)).join(''):'<div class="r113-card">Nenhum contrato ativo. Escolha um no quadro da guilda.</div>';
  $('r113Done').innerHTML=`Você concluiu <b>${q.done}</b> contratos nesta jornada. <br><small class="r113-muted">Derrotas de criaturas: ${q.stats.kills||0} · Chefes: ${q.stats.bosses||0} · Explorações: ${q.stats.explores||0} · Viagens: ${q.stats.travels||0} · Dungeons: ${q.stats.dungeons||0}</small><br><button style="margin-top:12px" onclick="RPG113.refresh()">Atualizar quadro (custa 100 ouro)</button>`;
 }
 function refresh(){const s=init();if(!s)return;if(s.gold<100)return toast('Você precisa de 100 ouro.');s.gold-=100;rollBoard(s.guild);save();render();if(typeof window.update==='function')window.update()}
 function bind(){
  if(window.__rpg113Bound)return;window.__rpg113Bound=true;
  const wrap=(name,type,successTest)=>{const old=window[name];if(typeof old!=='function')return;window[name]=function(...args){const before=S()?.[successTest]??0;const out=old.apply(this,args);const s=S();if(s){let inc=0;if(type==='travel'&&s.world!==before)inc=1;if(type==='explore'&&s.energy<before)inc=1;if(type==='dungeon'&&s.dungeonWins>before)inc=s.dungeonWins-before;if(type==='hunt'&&s.wins>before)inc=s.wins-before;if(type==='boss'&&s.bossKills>before)inc=s.bossKills-before;if(inc)update(type,inc)}return out}};
  wrap('travel','travel','world');wrap('explore','explore','energy');wrap('dungeon','dungeon','dungeonWins');wrap('resolve','hunt','wins');
  const oldResolve=window.resolve;
  if(typeof oldResolve==='function')window.resolve=function(...a){const before=S()?.bossKills||0;const result=oldResolve.apply(this,a);const s=S();if(s&&(s.bossKills||0)>before)update('boss',(s.bossKills||0)-before);return result};
 }
 function mount(){let grid=document.querySelector('.rpg87-grid');if(grid&&!$('rpg113Btn')){const b=document.createElement('button');b.id='rpg113Btn';b.textContent='🏹 GUILDA 11.3';b.onclick=open;grid.appendChild(b)}}
 window.RPG113={open,close,accept,claim,refresh,render};
 document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')close()});
 if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{mount();bind();render()},{once:true});else{mount();bind();render()}
 setTimeout(()=>{mount();bind()},1200);
})();
</script>


<style id="rpg114-npc-style">
#r114Btn{position:fixed;right:22px;bottom:190px;z-index:9998;border:1px solid #67e8f9;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#10233d,#39245e);color:#f3f7ff;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:14px;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 8px 28px #0009;cursor:pointer}
#r114Overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100000;background:#030712eF;backdrop-filter:blur(9px);padding:18px;overflow:auto;color:#eef5ff;font-family:inherit}
#r114Overlay.open{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
#r114Shell{width:min(1050px,100%);max-height:94vh;overflow:auto;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#101b31,#171329);border:1px solid #52658c;border-radius:22px;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 25px 90px #000b}
.r114-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.r114-head h2{margin:4px 0;font-size:clamp(22px,4vw,32px)}.r114-sub{color:#aabbd8;margin:5px 0 18px}.r114-close{background:#27334b;color:white;border:1px solid #52658c;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 13px;cursor:pointer}
.r114-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:12px}.r114-card{background:#ffffff0a;border:1px solid #344968;border-radius:16px;padding:15px}.r114-card h3{margin:3px 0 8px}.r114-muted{color:#a8b8d2;font-size:13px}.r114-pill{display:inline-block;border-radius:99px;padding:4px 9px;background:#243d5c;color:#bfeaff;font-size:11px;margin:2px}.r114-card button,.r114-action{border:1px solid #5279a9;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1b4970,#49306e);color:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 12px;margin:8px 5px 0 0;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700}.r114-card button:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}.r114-bar{height:7px;background:#27334b;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:7px}.r114-bar span{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#22d3ee,#a78bfa)}#r114Dialog{margin-top:14px;border:1px solid #6b5b91;background:#17152b;border-radius:16px;padding:17px;min-height:120px}.r114-choice{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;margin-top:8px;background:#202b45;color:#f3f7ff;border:1px solid #52658c;border-radius:10px;padding:11px;cursor:pointer}.r114-choice:hover{background:#30466b}.r114-statrow{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:12px 0}.r114-stat{background:#111e33;border:1px solid #344968;border-radius:12px;padding:9px 12px}.r114-stat b{color:#7dd3fc}
@media(max-width:600px){#r114Btn{right:10px;bottom:145px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:12px}#r114Overlay{padding:7px}#r114Shell{padding:13px;border-radius:15px;max-height:97vh}.r114-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>
<div id="r114Overlay" aria-hidden="true"><section id="r114Shell"><div class="r114-head"><div><span class="r114-pill">SISTEMA SOCIAL 11.4</span><h2>🏘️ Vila dos Ecos — Personagens</h2></div><button class="r114-close" onclick="RPG114.close()">Fechar ✕</button></div><p class="r114-sub">Conheça moradores, aceite tarefas, negocie itens e construa confiança. Suas escolhas ficam registradas na jornada.</p><div id="r114Stats" class="r114-statrow"></div><div id="r114People" class="r114-layout"></div><div id="r114Dialog"><span class="r114-muted">Escolha um personagem para conversar.</span></div></section></div>
<script id="rpg114-npc-engine">
(()=>{
 const $=id=>document.getElementById(id), S=()=>typeof g!=='undefined'&&g?g:null;
 const people=[
  {id:'arkan',name:'Arkan',role:'Arquivista',place:'Biblioteca de Eldoria',icon:'📚',bio:'Guarda mapas antigos e conhece os segredos das regiões.',hello:'As páginas mudam quando o Abismo desperta. Talvez você possa me ajudar a recuperar alguns registros.',quest:'Páginas Perdidas',task:'Visite duas regiões diferentes.',goal:2,reward:260,rep:12},
  {id:'kael',name:'Kael',role:'Mestre de armas',place:'Campo de treinamento',icon:'⚔️',bio:'Treina aventureiros e ensina a controlar o ritmo do combate.',hello:'Força sem disciplina é desperdício. Prove que sabe aprender com cada batalha.',quest:'Treino de Campo',task:'Vença três batalhas.',goal:3,reward:220,rep:10},
  {id:'mira',name:'Mira',role:'Comerciante',place:'Mercado da vila',icon:'🛒',bio:'Negocia suprimentos, poções e materiais de viagem.',hello:'Tenho algumas mercadorias úteis. Nada de fiado, aventureiro!',quest:'Ajuda ao Mercado',task:'Explore duas vezes para encontrar materiais.',goal:2,reward:180,rep:8},
  {id:'lyra',name:'Lyra',role:'Cuidadora de criaturas',place:'Estábulo',icon:'🐉',bio:'Estuda criaturas e ajuda a cuidar de companheiros.',hello:'Criaturas não são ferramentas. Primeiro precisamos conquistar a confiança delas.',quest:'Rastros Silenciosos',task:'Derrote duas criaturas.',goal:2,reward:240,rep:12},
  {id:'nox',name:'Nox',role:'Viajante noturno',place:'Portão antigo',icon:'🌙',bio:'Aparece em horários tardios e conhece passagens escondidas.',hello:'A noite revela caminhos que o dia não consegue mostrar.',quest:'Sinal na Escuridão',task:'Converse comigo e explore uma região.',goal:1,reward:320,rep:16,night:true},
  {id:'brann',name:'Brann',role:'Ferreiro',place:'Forja comunitária',icon:'🔨',bio:'Transforma materiais em melhorias para equipamentos.',hello:'Traga experiência e bons materiais. Uma arma bem cuidada pode salvar sua jornada.',quest:'A Forja Precisa de Ajuda',task:'Complete uma dungeon.',goal:1,reward:350,rep:15},
  {id:'selene',name:'Selene',role:'Curandeira',place:'Santuário',icon:'✨',bio:'Cuida dos viajantes e pesquisa antigas formas de proteção.',hello:'Até os aventureiros mais fortes precisam descansar. Posso preparar algo para sua próxima viagem.',quest:'Luz para os Viajantes',task:'Visite uma região nova.',goal:1,reward:200,rep:10},
  {id:'orik',name:'Orik',role:'Caçador veterano',place:'Mural de contratos',icon:'🏹',bio:'Conhece rastros, territórios e hábitos das criaturas.',hello:'Não persiga qualquer monstro. Observe o terreno e escolha o momento certo.',quest:'Território Seguro',task:'Derrote um chefe.',goal:1,reward:520,rep:22}
 ];
 function init(){const s=S();if(!s)return null;s.npcSocial=s.npcSocial||{relations:{},quests:{},talks:0,visited:[]};const n=s.npcSocial;n.relations=n.relations||{};n.quests=n.quests||{};people.forEach(p=>{if(!n.relations[p.id])n.relations[p.id]=0});return s}
 function save(){try{if(typeof window.save==='function')window.save()}catch(e){}}
 function notify(t){if(typeof window.log==='function')window.log('🧙 '+t);else console.info(t)}
 function available(p){if(!p.night)return true;const h=typeof timeInfo==='function'?timeInfo().h:12;return h>=20||h<5}
 function open(){if(!init()){notify('Comece ou carregue uma jornada antes de visitar a vila.');return}$('r114Overlay').classList.add('open');$('r114Overlay').setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');render()}
 function close(){$('r114Overlay').classList.remove('open');$('r114Overlay').setAttribute('aria-hidden','true')}
 function render(){const s=init();if(!s)return;const n=s.npcSocial;$('r114Stats').innerHTML=`<div class="r114-stat">🤝 <b>${n.talks}</b> conversas</div><div class="r114-stat">💠 <b>${Object.values(n.relations).filter(v=>v>=30).length}</b> aliados confiáveis</div><div class="r114-stat">📜 <b>${Object.values(n.quests).filter(q=>q.done).length}</b> tarefas concluídas</div>`;$('r114People').innerHTML=people.map(p=>{let rel=n.relations[p.id]||0,q=n.quests[p.id],openNow=available(p);return `<article class="r114-card"><span class="r114-pill">${p.role}</span><h3>${p.icon} ${p.name}</h3><p class="r114-muted">📍 ${p.place}</p><p>${p.bio}</p><div class="r114-muted">Confiança: ${rel}/100 ${!openNow?' · Aparece à noite':''}</div><div class="r114-bar"><span style="width:${rel}%"></span></div><p class="r114-muted">${q?.done?'Tarefa concluída':q?'Tarefa: '+p.quest+' ('+(q.progress||0)+'/'+p.goal+')':'Tarefa disponível: '+p.quest}</p><button onclick="RPG114.talk('${p.id}')" ${openNow?'':'disabled'}>${openNow?'Conversar':'Não está aqui agora'}</button></article>`}).join('')}
 function talk(id){const s=init(),p=people.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!s||!p)return;const n=s.npcSocial;if(!available(p)){notify(p.name+' só aparece durante a noite.');return}n.talks++;n.visited.push(id);n.relations[id]=Math.min(100,(n.relations[id]||0)+2);const q=n.quests[id];let actions='';if(!q)actions=`<button class="r114-choice" onclick="RPG114.accept('${id}')">📜 Aceitar tarefa: ${p.quest}</button>`;else if(!q.done&&q.progress>=p.goal)actions=`<button class="r114-choice" onclick="RPG114.claim('${id}')">🎁 Entregar tarefa e receber recompensa</button>`;else if(q.done)actions=`<button class="r114-choice" onclick="RPG114.greet('${id}')">💬 Perguntar novidades</button>`;else actions=`<div class="r114-muted">Tarefa em andamento: ${p.task} (${q.progress||0}/${p.goal})</div>`;
 const extra=id==='mira'?`<button class="r114-choice" onclick="RPG114.buyPotion()">🧪 Comprar poção de cura — 75 ouro</button>`:id==='kael'?`<button class="r114-choice" onclick="RPG114.train()">💪 Treinamento — 120 ouro</button>`:id==='selene'?`<button class="r114-choice" onclick="RPG114.heal()">💖 Recuperar vida e mana — 60 ouro</button>`:id==='brann'?`<button class="r114-choice" onclick="RPG114.forge()">🔧 Reforçar equipamento — 150 ouro</button>`:'';
 $('r114Dialog').innerHTML=`<span class="r114-pill">${p.role}</span><h3>${p.icon} ${p.name}</h3><p>${p.hello}</p><p class="r114-muted">${p.name} agora confia um pouco mais em você. Confiança: ${n.relations[id]}/100.</p>${actions}${extra}<button class="r114-choice" onclick="RPG114.closeDialog()">Encerrar conversa</button>`;save();render()}
 function closeDialog(){$('r114Dialog').innerHTML='<span class="r114-muted">Conversa encerrada. Escolha outro morador quando quiser.</span>'}
 function accept(id){const s=init(),p=people.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!s||!p)return;s.npcSocial.quests[id]={progress:0,done:false};notify('Nova tarefa: '+p.quest+'. '+p.task);save();talk(id)}
 function progress(type,n=1){const s=init();if(!s)return;const map={travel:['arkan','selene','nox'],explore:['mira','nox'],battle:['kael','lyra'],boss:['orik'],dungeon:['brann']};(map[type]||[]).forEach(id=>{const q=s.npcSocial.quests[id],p=people.find(x=>x.id===id);if(q&&!q.done&&p){q.progress=Math.min(p.goal,(q.progress||0)+n)}});save()}
 function claim(id){const s=init(),p=people.find(x=>x.id===id),q=s?.npcSocial.quests[id];if(!p||!q||q.done||q.progress<p.goal)return; q.done=true;s.gold=(s.gold||0)+p.reward;s.rep=(s.rep||0)+p.rep;s.npcSocial.relations[id]=Math.min(100,(s.npcSocial.relations[id]||0)+20);if(typeof window.gain==='function')window.gain(180);else s.xp=(s.xp||0)+180;s.inventory=s.inventory||[];s.inventory.push({name:'Lembrança de '+p.name,rarity:'Raro',level:s.level||1,price:0,atk:1,def:2,hp:5,mp:3,slot:'relic',passive:'Presente de um aliado'});notify('Tarefa concluída! +180 XP, +'+p.reward+' ouro e +'+p.rep+' reputação.');save();if(typeof window.update==='function')window.update();talk(id)}
 function greet(id){const p=people.find(x=>x.id===id);if(p)$('r114Dialog').insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin',`<p class="r114-muted">${p.name}: Obrigado por manter nossa vila segura. Há sempre algo novo acontecendo pelo mundo.</p>`)}
 function spend(cost){const s=init();if(!s||s.gold<cost){notify('Ouro insuficiente.');return null}s.gold-=cost;return s}
 function buyPotion(){const s=spend(75);if(!s)return;s.inventory=s.inventory||[];s.inventory.push({name:'Poção da Vila',rarity:'Comum',level:s.level||1,price:35,atk:0,def:0,hp:35,mp:0,slot:'consumable',passive:'Poção de cura'});notify('Poção adicionada ao inventário.');save();if(typeof window.update==='function')window.update();talk('mira')}
 function train(){const s=spend(120);if(!s)return;s.attack=(s.attack||0)+3;s.defense=(s.defense||0)+2;notify('Treinamento concluído: +3 ataque e +2 defesa.');save();if(typeof window.update==='function')window.update();talk('kael')}
 function heal(){const s=spend(60);if(!s)return;s.hp=s.maxHp||s.hp;s.mana=s.maxMana||s.mana;notify('Você recuperou suas energias.');save();if(typeof window.update==='function')window.update();talk('selene')}
 function forge(){const s=spend(150);if(!s)return;s.attack=(s.attack||0)+2;s.defense=(s.defense||0)+3;notify('Equipamento reforçado: +2 ataque e +3 defesa.');save();if(typeof window.update==='function')window.update();talk('brann')}
 function mount(){const grid=document.querySelector('.rpg87-grid');if(grid&&!$('r114Btn')){const b=document.createElement('button');b.id='r114Btn';b.textContent='🏘️ VILA & NPCs 11.4';b.onclick=open;grid.appendChild(b)}}
 function bind(){if(window.__rpg114Bound)return;window.__rpg114Bound=true;const wrap=(name,type,read)=>{const old=window[name];if(typeof old!=='function')return;window[name]=function(...a){const before=read();const out=old.apply(this,a);const after=read();if(after>before)progress(type,after-before);return out}};wrap('travel','travel',()=>S()?.world||0);wrap('explore','explore',()=>-(S()?.energy||0));wrap('resolve','battle',()=>S()?.wins||0);wrap('dungeon','dungeon',()=>S()?.dungeonWins||0);const oldResolve=window.resolve;if(typeof oldResolve==='function')window.resolve=function(...a){const before=S()?.bossKills||0;const out=oldResolve.apply(this,a);const after=S()?.bossKills||0;if(after>before)progress('boss',after-before);return out}}
 window.RPG114={open,close,talk,accept,claim,greet,closeDialog,buyPotion,train,heal,forge,render};document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')close()});if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{mount();bind()},{once:true});else{mount();bind()}setTimeout(()=>{mount();bind()},1300);
})();
</script>


<style id="rpg115-expansion-style">
#r115Btn{position:fixed;right:22px;bottom:205px;z-index:9997;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid #f59e0b88;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#25152b,#56320d);color:#fff3d4;font-weight:950;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #0009;cursor:pointer}
#r115Overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100001;background:#030712ed;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);overflow:auto;padding:18px;color:#edf5ff}#r115Overlay.show{display:block}.r115-shell{max-width:1160px;margin:18px auto;padding:22px;border:1px solid #f59e0b55;border-radius:22px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#101827,#21152a);box-shadow:0 25px 90px #000}.r115-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px}.r115-head h2{margin:0}.r115-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:18px 0}.r115-tabs button,.r115-card button,.r115-close{border:1px solid #f59e0b55;background:#2b2330;color:#fff0d4;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 13px;font-weight:850;cursor:pointer}.r115-tabs button.active{background:#854d0e}.r115-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}.r115-card{padding:15px;border:1px solid #ffffff18;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#172235,#241a2b);min-width:0}.r115-card h3{margin:0 0 7px}.r115-card p{color:#b9c7d8;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}.r115-meta{display:inline-block;margin:2px;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:20px;background:#f59e0b20;color:#fcdba2;font-size:11px}.r115-locked{opacity:.55}.r115-note{margin:14px 0;padding:12px;border-left:3px solid #f59e0b;background:#ffffff08;border-radius:8px;color:#cbd5e1}@media(max-width:760px){#r115Btn{right:10px;bottom:210px}.r115-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.r115-shell{padding:14px}}@media(max-width:480px){.r115-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>
<button id="r115Btn" type="button">🌍 NOVOS MUNDOS & CHEFES</button>
<div id="r115Overlay" aria-hidden="true"><section class="r115-shell"><div class="r115-head"><div><span class="r115-meta">CAMPANHA 11.7</span><h2>🌌 Crônicas do Abismo Infinito</h2><p style="color:#aebed0;margin:6px 0">Novas regiões, guardiões e desafios para sua campanha.</p></div><button class="r115-close" id="r115Close">Fechar ✕</button></div><div class="r115-tabs"><button class="active" data-tab="worlds">🗺️ Mundos</button><button data-tab="bosses">👑 Chefes</button></div><div id="r115Content"></div><div class="r115-note" id="r115Message">Explore as regiões e enfrente seus guardiões. Os requisitos usam o nível atual do personagem.</div></section></div>
<script id="rpg115-expansion-engine">/* Engine replaced by integrated 11.6 campaign engine below. */</script>


<style id="rpg116-professional-style">
#r115Btn{right:22px;bottom:205px;z-index:9997;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#10243c,#35204b 55%,#6b3d13);border:1px solid #d6a84c;color:#fff4d6;letter-spacing:.3px;box-shadow:0 12px 36px #000b,0 0 22px #b7791f22}
.r116-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin:16px 0}.r116-stat{padding:12px;border:1px solid #ffffff18;border-radius:13px;background:#ffffff08}.r116-stat b{display:block;font-size:19px;color:#f8d78a}.r116-stat small{color:#9fb0c4}.r116-progress{height:8px;background:#0a1020;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:7px}.r116-progress span{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#38bdf8,#a78bfa,#f59e0b);border-radius:99px}.r116-search{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #334155;background:#081222;color:#fff;margin:5px 0 14px;outline:none}.r116-card{position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .18s,border-color .18s}.r116-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:#d6a84c88}.r116-card:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;width:3px;background:linear-gradient(#38bdf8,#a78bfa,#f59e0b)}.r116-card h3{padding-left:5px}.r116-card .r116-status{font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.7px;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:30px;display:inline-block;margin-bottom:8px;background:#172d43;color:#bae6fd}.r116-card .r116-status.done{background:#123527;color:#86efac}.r116-card .r116-status.lock{background:#3b2630;color:#fda4af}.r116-card button:disabled{opacity:.42;cursor:not-allowed}.r116-card button{width:100%;margin-top:6px}.r116-foot{font-size:11px;color:#91a2b8;margin-top:12px;line-height:1.5}.r116-empty{padding:25px;text-align:center;border:1px dashed #475569;border-radius:14px;color:#9fb0c4}
@media(max-width:760px){.r116-top{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
</style>
<script id="rpg116-integrated-campaign">
(()=>{'use strict';
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),overlay=$('r115Overlay');if(!overlay)return;
const expansion=[
{name:'🌸 Jardim das Cinzas',level:35,boss:'Amaryth, Rainha das Cinzas',hp:30000,atk:1050,def:420,phases:3,reward:'Semente da Fênix',rarity:'Lendário',desc:'Um jardim eterno onde flores nascem das memórias dos antigos heróis.',biome:'Ruínas floridas'},
{name:'🏜️ Deserto dos Reis Sepultados',level:50,boss:'Kharzum, Rei Sob a Areia',hp:52000,atk:1450,def:680,phases:3,reward:'Coroa de Dunas',rarity:'Lendário',desc:'Templos soterrados escondem os pactos de reis esquecidos.',biome:'Deserto ancestral'},
{name:'🌩️ Arquipélago da Tempestade',level:65,boss:'Raikou, Coração da Tormenta',hp:85000,atk:1950,def:950,phases:4,reward:'Núcleo da Tempestade',rarity:'Lendário',desc:'Ilhas suspensas entre relâmpagos e mares revoltos.',biome:'Ilhas tempestuosas'},
{name:'🩸 Vale Carmesim',level:80,boss:'Vespera, A Matriarca Rubra',hp:125000,atk:2500,def:1350,phases:4,reward:'Cristal Carmesim',rarity:'Lendário',desc:'Um vale tomado por uma energia antiga que transforma a paisagem.',biome:'Vale sombrio'},
{name:'🍄 Reino dos Fungos Colossais',level:95,boss:'Murog, Titã Micelial',hp:180000,atk:3200,def:1800,phases:4,reward:'Coração Micelial',rarity:'Lendário',desc:'Uma floresta subterrânea conectada por raízes gigantes.',biome:'Cavernas vivas'},
{name:'🧊 Coroa Boreal',level:110,boss:'Skadi, Guardiã do Inverno',hp:250000,atk:4100,def:2300,phases:4,reward:'Fragmento Boreal',rarity:'Lendário',desc:'Uma cidadela congelada onde o vento guarda vozes distantes.',biome:'Montanhas glaciais'},
{name:'⚙️ Necrópole Mecânica',level:125,boss:'Axiom-9, Regente de Ferro',hp:340000,atk:5200,def:3100,phases:5,reward:'Engrenagem Ancestral',rarity:'Lendário',desc:'Uma cidade automatizada continua executando ordens de um império extinto.',biome:'Cidade mecânica'},
{name:'🌠 Observatório Celestial',level:145,boss:'Orion, Vigia das Constelações',hp:470000,atk:6800,def:4200,phases:5,reward:'Olho Estelar',rarity:'Lendário',desc:'Uma fortaleza acima das nuvens observa as linhas do destino.',biome:'Céu astral'},
{name:'🕳️ Fenda do Primeiro Abismo',level:165,boss:'MALACHAR, O Primeiro Eco',hp:680000,atk:8600,def:5600,phases:5,reward:'Selo do Primeiro Abismo',rarity:'Lendário',desc:'A primeira rachadura da realidade ainda pulsa sob o mundo.',biome:'Dimensão instável'},
{name:'👁️ Trono das Possibilidades',level:185,boss:'Elyon, Juiz das Realidades',hp:950000,atk:10800,def:7200,phases:6,reward:'Íris das Possibilidades',rarity:'Lendário',desc:'Cada porta revela uma versão diferente da sua própria jornada.',biome:'Plano multiversal'}
];
function player(){try{return typeof g!=='undefined'&&g?g:null}catch(e){return null}}
function defeated(w){const p=player();return !!p&&(p.defeated||[]).includes(w.boss)}
function unlocked(i){const p=player();if(!p||p.level<expansion[i].level)return false;if(i===0)return true;return defeated(expansion[i-1])}
function installCore(){
 if(typeof W==='undefined'||typeof B==='undefined'||typeof BOSSLOOT==='undefined')return false;
 if(!window.__rpg116Core){
  expansion.forEach(w=>{if(!W.some(x=>x[2]===w.boss)){W.push([w.name,w.level,w.boss]);B[w.boss]=[w.hp,w.atk,w.def,w.phases];BOSSLOOT[w.boss]=w.reward;}});
  if(typeof travel==='function'){
   const originalTravel=travel;
   window.__rpg116TravelOriginal=originalTravel;
   window.travel=function(i){if(i>=9){const n=i-9;if(n<0||n>=expansion.length)return;if(!unlocked(n)){if(typeof log==='function')log(n===0?'🔒 Requer nível '+expansion[n].level+'.':'🔒 Derrote '+expansion[n-1].boss+' para abrir esta região.');return;} }return originalTravel(i)};
  }
  window.__rpg116Core=true;
 }
 return true;
}
function stats(){const p=player();if(!p)return '<div class="r116-empty">Carregue ou crie um personagem para acompanhar a campanha.</div>';let done=expansion.filter(defeated).length,lv=p.level||1,percent=Math.round(done/10*100);return `<div class="r116-top"><div class="r116-stat"><b>⭐ ${lv}</b><small>Nível do herói</small></div><div class="r116-stat"><b>👑 ${done}/10</b><small>Chefes derrotados</small></div><div class="r116-stat"><b>🌍 ${Math.min(10,done+1)}/10</b><small>Etapas liberadas</small></div><div class="r116-stat"><b>💾 Ativo</b><small>Progressão integrada</small></div></div><div class="r116-progress"><span style="width:${percent}%"></span></div><div class="r116-foot">Progresso da expansão: ${percent}% · A vitória registra o chefe, concede a relíquia e salva a campanha.</div>`}
function render(tab='worlds',query=''){
 const p=player();document.querySelectorAll('.r115-tabs button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.tab===tab));
 const q=(query||'').trim().toLocaleLowerCase('pt-BR');let html=stats();html+='<input class="r116-search" id="r116Search" placeholder="⌕ Buscar mundo, bioma ou guardião..." value="'+query.replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]))+'">';
 const cards=expansion.map((w,i)=>({w,i})).filter(({w})=>(w.name+' '+w.boss+' '+w.biome+' '+w.desc).toLocaleLowerCase('pt-BR').includes(q));
 if(!cards.length)html+='<div class="r116-empty">Nenhum mundo encontrado. Tente outro termo.</div>';
 else html+='<div class="r115-grid">'+cards.map(({w,i})=>{let done=defeated(w),open=unlocked(i),p=player(),current=p&&p.world===i+9;let status=done?'CONCLUÍDO':!open?'BLOQUEADO':current?'REGIÃO ATUAL':'DISPONÍVEL';return `<article class="r115-card r116-card"><span class="r116-status ${done?'done':!open?'lock':''}">${status}</span><span class="r115-meta">${w.biome} · Nível ${w.level}+</span><h3>${w.name}</h3><p>${w.desc}</p><p>👑 Guardião: <b>${w.boss}</b><br>❤️ Vitalidade: ${w.hp.toLocaleString('pt-BR')}<br>⚔️ Fases: ${w.phases}<br>🎁 Relíquia: ${w.reward}</p><button data-r116-travel="${i}" ${open?'':'disabled'}>🧭 Entrar na região</button><button data-r116-boss="${i}" ${open&&!done?'':'disabled'}>⚔️ ${done?'Guardião derrotado': 'Desafiar guardião'}</button></article>`}).join('')+'</div>';
 $('r115Content').innerHTML=html;$('r115Message').textContent='Expansão 11.6 · Mundos conectados ao mapa, combate, recompensas e save principal.';
 const input=$('r116Search');if(input)input.addEventListener('input',()=>render(tab,input.value));
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-r116-travel]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>enter(+b.dataset.r116Travel));document.querySelectorAll('[data-r116-boss]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>challenge(+b.dataset.r116Boss));
}
function enter(i){const p=player(),w=expansion[i];if(!p||!unlocked(i))return;if(p.enemy){$('r115Message').textContent='Termine o combate atual antes de viajar.';return;}if(typeof window.travel==='function')window.travel(9+i);p.region=w.name;p.world=9+i;if(typeof window.save==='function')window.save();if(typeof window.update==='function')window.update();$('r115Message').textContent='Você chegou a '+w.name+'. O guardião '+w.boss+' aguarda.';render('worlds')}
function challenge(i){const p=player(),w=expansion[i];if(!p||!unlocked(i)||defeated(w))return;if(p.enemy){$('r115Message').textContent='Você já está em combate. Vença ou fuja antes de iniciar outro desafio.';return;}enter(i);if(p.world!==9+i)return;if(typeof boss==='function'){boss();$('r115Message').textContent='⚔️ '+w.boss+' entrou no combate principal! Use os comandos normais de batalha. A vitória concederá '+w.reward+'.';}else{$('r115Message').textContent='O sistema principal de chefes não está disponível. Recarregue o jogo e tente novamente.';} }
 function open(){overlay.classList.add('show');overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');render('worlds')}
 $('r115Btn').textContent='🌌 CAMPANHA 11.6';$('r115Btn').onclick=open;$('r115Close').onclick=()=>{overlay.classList.remove('show');overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true')};overlay.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===overlay)$('r115Close').click()});document.querySelectorAll('.r115-tabs button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>render(b.dataset.tab));document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&overlay.classList.contains('show'))$('r115Close').click()});
 installCore();const oldBossLoot=typeof bossLoot==='function'?bossLoot:null;
 // The main game's existing bossLoot() reads BOSSLOOT, so each expansion relic is granted by the normal victory flow.
 if(oldBossLoot){expansion.forEach(w=>{BOSSLOOT[w.boss]=w.reward;});}
 if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',installCore,{once:true});
})();
</script>


<style id="rpg117-professional-board">
.r117-wrap{margin:14px 0 18px}.r117-hero{padding:18px;border:1px solid #7dd3fc44;border-radius:18px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 90% 0%,#7c3aed30,transparent 38%),linear-gradient(135deg,#101c31,#171329)}.r117-hero h3{margin:0 0 6px;color:#f8e7b5}.r117-hero p{margin:0;color:#aebed0;font-size:13px}.r117-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:12px}.r117-card{border:1px solid #ffffff1c;border-radius:15px;padding:14px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#14243a,#21192e);min-width:0}.r117-card h4{margin:0 0 7px;color:#f5dfaa}.r117-card p{font-size:12px;color:#aebed0;line-height:1.5}.r117-meter{height:7px;background:#070e1b;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;margin:10px 0}.r117-meter span{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#38bdf8,#a78bfa,#fbbf24)}.r117-card button{width:100%;margin-top:7px;padding:10px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #d6a84c66;background:#372b27;color:#ffe9bd;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer}.r117-card button:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}.r117-tag{display:inline-block;font-size:10px;padding:4px 7px;border-radius:20px;background:#38bdf822;color:#bae6fd;margin-bottom:7px}.r117-ach{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}.r117-ach .medal{font-size:26px}.r117-muted{color:#91a2b8;font-size:11px}@media(max-width:760px){.r117-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}@media(max-width:480px){.r117-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>
<script id="rpg117-contracts-achievements">
(()=>{'use strict';
if(window.__rpg117Installed)return;window.__rpg117Installed=true;
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const player=()=>{try{return typeof g!=='undefined'?g:null}catch(e){return null}};
const dayKey=()=>{const d=new Date();return [d.getFullYear(),String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'),String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')].join('-')};
const daily=[
 {id:'slayer',icon:'👑',name:'Caçador de Guardiões',desc:'Derrote 1 chefe em qualquer região.',goal:1,field:'bosses',gold:650,xp:900},
 {id:'veteran',icon:'⚔️',name:'Treino de Combate',desc:'Vença 5 encontros.',goal:5,field:'wins',gold:380,xp:520},
 {id:'wanderer',icon:'🧭',name:'Peregrino',desc:'Viaje 2 vezes entre regiões.',goal:2,field:'travels',gold:300,xp:450}
];
function state(){const p=player();if(!p)return null;p.campaign117=p.campaign117||{};const c=p.campaign117;if(c.day!==dayKey()){c.day=dayKey();c.progress={bosses:0,wins:0,travels:0};c.claimed=[];}c.progress=c.progress||{bosses:0,wins:0,travels:0};c.claimed=c.claimed||[];c.history=c.history||[];return c}
function save(){try{if(typeof window.save==='function')window.save()}catch(e){}}
function progress(field,n=1){const c=state();if(!c||n<=0)return;c.progress[field]=(c.progress[field]||0)+n;save()}
function rewards(id){const p=player(),c=state(),q=daily.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!p||!c||!q||c.claimed.includes(id)||(c.progress[q.field]||0)<q.goal)return;c.claimed.push(id);p.gold=(p.gold||0)+q.gold;if(typeof window.gain==='function')window.gain(q.xp);else p.xp=(p.xp||0)+q.xp;c.history.unshift({name:q.name,date:dayKey(),gold:q.gold,xp:q.xp});c.history=c.history.slice(0,30);save();if(typeof window.update==='function')window.update();render('contracts');const msg=$('r115Message');if(msg)msg.textContent=`Contrato concluído: +${q.gold} ouro e +${q.xp} XP.`}
const milestones=[
 {id:'first',icon:'🗡️',name:'Primeira Vitória',desc:'Vença seu primeiro combate.',test:p=>p.wins>=1,reward:'Marco de início'},
 {id:'boss5',icon:'👑',name:'Lenda dos Guardiões',desc:'Derrote 5 chefes.',test:p=>(p.bossKills||0)>=5,reward:'Título: Guardião Lendário'},
 {id:'boss10',icon:'🌌',name:'Além das Fronteiras',desc:'Derrote os 10 guardiões da expansão.',test:p=>expansion.every(w=>(p.defeated||[]).includes(w.boss)),reward:'Título: Caminhante do Abismo'},
 {id:'level100',icon:'⭐',name:'Poder Desperto',desc:'Alcance o nível 100.',test:p=>p.level>=100,reward:'Título: Ascendente'},
 {id:'wealth',icon:'💰',name:'Fortuna Abissal',desc:'Acumule 10.000 moedas.',test:p=>p.gold>=10000,reward:'Título: Magnata'},
 {id:'ngplus',icon:'♾️',name:'Ciclo Eterno',desc:'Inicie uma jornada New Game+.',test:p=>p.ng>=1,reward:'Título: Renascido'}
];
function render(tab){const p=player(),c=state();if(!p||!c){$('r115Content').innerHTML='<div class="r116-empty">Crie ou carregue um personagem para acessar contratos e conquistas.</div>';return}
 document.querySelectorAll('.r115-tabs button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.tab===tab));
 let html='';
 if(tab==='contracts'){
  html=`<div class="r117-wrap"><div class="r117-hero"><h3>📜 Quadro de Contratos Diários</h3><p>Complete objetivos durante sua jornada. Os contratos renovam diariamente; cada recompensa só pode ser coletada uma vez.</p></div><div class="r117-grid">`;
  html+=daily.map(q=>{const n=Math.min(q.goal,c.progress[q.field]||0),done=n>=q.goal,claimed=c.claimed.includes(q.id);return `<article class="r117-card"><span class="r117-tag">${claimed?'RECOMPENSA COLETADA':done?'CONCLUÍDO':'CONTRATO DIÁRIO'}</span><h4>${q.icon} ${q.name}</h4><p>${q.desc}</p><b>${n}/${q.goal}</b><div class="r117-meter"><span style="width:${Math.min(100,n/q.goal*100)}%"></span></div><p>🎁 ${q.gold} ouro · ✨ ${q.xp} XP</p><button data-r117-claim="${q.id}" ${!done||claimed?'disabled':''}>${claimed?'Coletado':done?'Resgatar recompensa':'Em andamento'}</button></article>`}).join('');
  html+='</div><p class="r117-muted">Data do ciclo: '+dayKey()+' · O progresso é salvo junto ao personagem neste navegador.</p></div>';
 }else if(tab==='achievements'){
  const unlocked=milestones.filter(m=>m.test(p));const claimed=p.campaign117.badges||[];
  html=`<div class="r117-wrap"><div class="r117-hero"><h3>🏆 Galeria de Conquistas</h3><p>Marcos permanentes da sua aventura. As conquistas são verificadas pelo progresso real do personagem.</p><b>${unlocked.length}/${milestones.length} desbloqueadas</b></div><div class="r117-grid">`;
  html+=milestones.map(m=>{const ok=m.test(p);return `<article class="r117-card"><div class="r117-ach"><span class="medal">${ok?m.icon:'🔒'}</span><div><h4>${m.name}</h4><span class="r117-tag">${ok?'DESBLOQUEADA':'BLOQUEADA'}</span></div></div><p>${m.desc}</p><p>🏅 ${m.reward}</p></article>`}).join('');html+='</div></div>';
 }else return renderWorldsOriginal(tab);
 $('r115Content').innerHTML=html;document.querySelectorAll('[data-r117-claim]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>rewards(b.dataset.r117Claim));$('r115Message').textContent='Campanha 11.7 · Contratos e conquistas vinculados ao personagem.';
}
// Os botões originais mantêm seus próprios handlers para as abas de mundos e chefes.
const baseTabHandlers={};
function installTabs(){const tabs=document.querySelector('.r115-tabs');if(!tabs)return;tabs.querySelectorAll('button[data-tab="worlds"],button[data-tab="bosses"]').forEach(b=>{if(!baseTabHandlers[b.dataset.tab])baseTabHandlers[b.dataset.tab]=b.onclick});if(!tabs.querySelector('[data-tab="contracts"]')){const b=document.createElement('button');b.dataset.tab='contracts';b.textContent='📜 Contratos';tabs.appendChild(b);const a=document.createElement('button');a.dataset.tab='achievements';a.textContent='🏆 Conquistas';tabs.appendChild(a)}tabs.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>{if(b.dataset.r117Bound)return;b.dataset.r117Bound='1';b.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(b.dataset.tab==='contracts'||b.dataset.tab==='achievements'){render(b.dataset.tab)}else{tabs.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x===b));if(typeof baseTabHandlers[b.dataset.tab]==='function')baseTabHandlers[b.dataset.tab].call(b)}})})}
function hook(name,field,read){const old=window[name];if(typeof old!=='function'||old.__r117)return;const wrapped=function(...args){const before=read();const out=old.apply(this,args);const after=read();if(after>before)progress(field,after-before);return out};wrapped.__r117=true;window[name]=wrapped}
function install(){installTabs();const p=player();if(p)state();hook('resolve','wins',()=>player()?.wins||0);hook('travel','travels',()=>player()?.campaign117?.travelCount||0);const oldTravel=window.travel;if(typeof oldTravel==='function'&&!oldTravel.__r117Travel){const wrapped=function(...args){const p=player(),before=p?.world;const out=oldTravel.apply(this,args);const after=player()?.world;if(p&&after!==before){const c=state();c.travelCount=(c.travelCount||0)+1;progress('travels',1)}return out};wrapped.__r117Travel=true;window.travel=wrapped}
 const oldResolve=window.resolve;if(typeof oldResolve==='function'&&!oldResolve.__r117Boss){const wrapped=function(...args){const before=player()?.bossKills||0;const out=oldResolve.apply(this,args);const after=player()?.bossKills||0;if(after>before)progress('bosses',after-before);return out};wrapped.__r117Boss=true;window.resolve=wrapped}
}
// Keep the original campaign renderer available through a safe wrapper before replacing only the new tabs.
const oldOpen=$('r115Btn')?.onclick;if($('r115Btn'))$('r115Btn').onclick=()=>{if(typeof oldOpen==='function')oldOpen();installTabs()};
installTabs();if($('r115Btn'))$('r115Btn').addEventListener('click',()=>setTimeout(installTabs,0));
const oldUpdate=window.update;if(typeof oldUpdate==='function'&&!oldUpdate.__r117){const wrapped=function(...a){const out=oldUpdate.apply(this,a);installTabs();return out};wrapped.__r117=true;window.update=wrapped}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',install,{once:true});else install();setTimeout(install,500);setTimeout(install,1600);
})();
</script>


<style id="rpg118-art-style">
.rpg118-gallery{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:9px;margin:16px 0 20px}
.rpg118-art{position:relative;display:block;overflow:hidden;padding:0!important;margin:0!important;height:130px;border:1px solid #6d5aa5!important;border-radius:13px!important;background:#080d1a!important;box-shadow:0 8px 25px #0008}
.rpg118-art img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .35s,filter .35s}
.rpg118-art:hover img{transform:scale(1.06);filter:brightness(1.12)}
.rpg118-art span{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:9px 8px;text-align:left;font-weight:900;font-size:12px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(transparent,#030712ee);text-shadow:0 2px 5px #000}
.rpg118-game-scene{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;min-height:210px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #604b9b;border-radius:16px;margin:10px 0 12px;background:#070b18;box-shadow:0 12px 32px #0008}
.rpg118-game-scene img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 52%;opacity:.88}
.rpg118-game-scene:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#030712e8 0%,#03071266 50%,transparent 100%),linear-gradient(0deg,#030712aa,transparent 65%)}
.rpg118-game-scene div{position:relative;z-index:1;padding:18px;display:grid;gap:5px;max-width:560px;text-shadow:0 2px 8px #000}
.rpg118-game-scene small{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#c4b5fd;font-weight:900}
.rpg118-game-scene strong{font-size:clamp(20px,3vw,32px);color:#fff}
.rpg118-game-scene span{font-size:13px;color:#dbeafe}
#rpg118Lightbox{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100100;background:#02030af2;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
#rpg118Lightbox.show{display:flex}#rpg118Lightbox img{max-width:min(1100px,94vw);max-height:82vh;object-fit:contain;border:1px solid #8b5cf6;border-radius:15px;box-shadow:0 20px 80px #000}
#rpg118Lightbox button{position:absolute;top:18px;right:18px;background:#271344;border:1px solid #a78bfa}
@media(max-width:850px){.rpg118-gallery{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.rpg118-mainart{grid-column:span 2;height:165px}.rpg118-art{height:115px}}
@media(max-width:520px){.rpg118-game-scene{min-height:165px}.rpg118-gallery{gap:6px}}
</style>
<div id="rpg118Lightbox" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Visualizar arte" onclick="if(event.target===this)RPG118.close()"><button type="button" onclick="RPG118.close()">✕ Fechar</button><img id="rpg118LightboxImg" alt="Arte ampliada do jogo"></div>
<script id="rpg118-art-gallery">
(()=>{const art={'castle':'data:image/jpeg;base64,', 'fire':'data:image/jpeg;base64,', 'ice':'data:image/jpeg;base64,', 'hero':'data:image/jpeg;base64,'};const box=document.getElementById('rpg118Lightbox'),img=document.getElementById('rpg118LightboxImg');window.RPG118={open(key){if(!art[key])return;img.src=art[key];box.classList.add('show')},close(){box.classList.remove('show');img.removeAttribute('src')}};document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')RPG118.close()})})();
</script>


<style id="rpg119-interface-polish">
/* Os atalhos extras só aparecem durante o jogo, nunca na tela inicial/cadastro. */
#r115Btn,#rpg11Btn,#r101BossBtn{display:none!important;position:fixed!important;right:16px!important;left:auto!important;width:210px!important;max-width:calc(100vw - 32px)!important;min-height:43px!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;border-radius:13px!important;padding:10px 13px!important;font-size:12px!important;line-height:1.2!important;z-index:55020!important;box-shadow:0 9px 28px #000b,0 0 18px #8b5cf633!important;backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
#r115Btn.rpg119-visible,#rpg11Btn.rpg119-visible,#r101BossBtn.rpg119-visible{display:block!important}
#r115Btn{bottom:158px!important;border:1px solid #e9bd62!important;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#3b2454,#75420f)!important;color:#fff2d2!important}
#rpg11Btn{bottom:105px!important;border:1px solid #4dd8ee!important;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#123c59,#30236b)!important;color:#e1faff!important}
#r101BossBtn{bottom:52px!important;border:1px solid #b58aff!important;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#20133f,#4b1d65)!important;color:#f6eaff!important}
#r115Btn:hover,#rpg11Btn:hover,#r101BossBtn:hover{filter:brightness(1.18)!important;transform:translateY(-2px)!important}
.rpg119-gallery{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px;margin:12px 0 18px}
.rpg119-tile{position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-width:0;height:112px;border-radius:13px;border:1px solid #7c6bb7;background:#080d1a;cursor:zoom-in;padding:0;margin:0;box-shadow:0 8px 22px #0008}
.rpg119-tile img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .3s,filter .3s}
.rpg119-tile:hover img{transform:scale(1.07);filter:brightness(1.15)}
.rpg119-tile span{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;padding:8px 6px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,#020611ed);color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;text-align:left}
.rpg119-heading{margin:14px 0 5px;color:#d8c7ff;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase}
@media(max-width:600px){#r115Btn,#rpg11Btn,#r101BossBtn{right:9px!important;width:190px!important;max-width:calc(100vw - 18px)!important;font-size:11px!important}#r115Btn{bottom:150px!important}#rpg11Btn{bottom:99px!important}#r101BossBtn{bottom:48px!important}.rpg119-gallery{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px}.rpg119-tile{height:100px}}
</style>
<script id="rpg119-interface-polish-js">
(()=>{'use strict';
const imgs={'boss':'data:image/jpeg;base64,','portal':'data:image/jpeg;base64,','reward':'data:image/jpeg;base64,','world':'data:image/jpeg;base64,'};
const gallery=document.querySelector('.rpg118-gallery');
const game=document.getElementById('game');
const buttons=['r115Btn','rpg11Btn','r101BossBtn'].map(id=>document.getElementById(id)).filter(Boolean);
function syncDock(){const playing=!!game&&game.classList.contains('active');buttons.forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('rpg119-visible',playing));}
if(gallery){
 const title=document.createElement('div');title.className='rpg119-heading';title.textContent='Galeria do Abismo • explore as artes';gallery.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',title);
 const extra=document.createElement('div');extra.className='rpg119-gallery';extra.setAttribute('aria-label','Artes adicionais dos mundos e desafios');
 [['boss','Dragão ancestral'],['portal','Portal dimensional'],['world','Reinos perdidos'],['reward','Tesouro lendário']].forEach(([key,label])=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='rpg119-tile';b.innerHTML='<img alt="'+label+'" loading="lazy"><span>'+label+'</span>';b.querySelector('img').src=imgs[key];b.addEventListener('click',()=>{const box=document.getElementById('rpg118Lightbox'),image=document.getElementById('rpg118LightboxImg');if(box&&image){image.src=imgs[key];box.classList.add('show')}});extra.appendChild(b)});
 gallery.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',extra);
}
const scene=document.querySelector('#game .rpg118-game-scene');
if(scene&&!scene.nextElementSibling?.classList.contains('rpg119-game-gallery')){const wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.className='rpg119-game-gallery';wrap.innerHTML='<div class="rpg119-heading">Regiões em destaque</div><div class="rpg119-gallery"></div>';const row=wrap.querySelector('.rpg119-gallery');[['world','Reinos'],['boss','Chefes'],['portal','Portais'],['reward','Relíquias']].forEach(([key,label])=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='rpg119-tile';b.innerHTML='<img alt="'+label+'" loading="lazy"><span>'+label+'</span>';b.querySelector('img').src=imgs[key];b.addEventListener('click',()=>{const box=document.getElementById('rpg118Lightbox'),image=document.getElementById('rpg118LightboxImg');if(box&&image){image.src=imgs[key];box.classList.add('show')}});row.appendChild(b)});scene.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',wrap)}
const observer=new MutationObserver(syncDock);document.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(el=>observer.observe(el,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']}));syncDock();
})();
</script>


<style id="rpg120-atmosphere">
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{position:relative;isolation:isolate;background:#030611}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:-2%;z-index:-2;pointer-events:none;background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(2,5,16,.70),rgba(2,5,16,.82)),url("data:image/webp;base64,");background-size:cover;background-position:center;background-repeat:no-repeat;filter:saturate(1.12);transform:scale(1.02);animation:rpg120-drift 42s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
body::after{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 35%,transparent 0%,rgba(1,3,12,.25) 58%,rgba(1,3,12,.72) 100%);}
@keyframes rpg120-drift{from{transform:scale(1.02) translate3d(-.3%,0,0)}to{transform:scale(1.08) translate3d(.3%,-.5%,0)}}
.screen{background:rgba(2,6,18,.18);backdrop-filter:blur(1px)}
.card,.panel,.stat,.app .box,.app .section{backdrop-filter:blur(8px);background-color:rgba(7,13,29,.88)}
.rpg120-audio{position:fixed;z-index:1000003;right:14px;top:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 11px;border:1px solid #9b83ff;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,rgba(8,16,39,.96),rgba(45,20,75,.96));box-shadow:0 5px 24px #0009,0 0 18px #7c3aed44;color:#fff;font:700 12px Arial,sans-serif}
.rpg120-audio button{margin:0;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:30px;background:linear-gradient(100deg,#1d4ed8,#7e22ce);font-size:12px}
.rpg120-audio small{color:#c4b5fd;white-space:nowrap}
.rpg120-audio .rpg120-led{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#64748b;box-shadow:0 0 8px currentColor}
.rpg120-audio.on .rpg120-led{background:#34d399;color:#34d399}
@media(max-width:600px){.rpg120-audio{top:8px;right:8px;padding:6px 8px}.rpg120-audio small{display:none}.rpg120-audio button{padding:7px 9px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){body::before{animation:none}*{scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition:none!important}}
</style>
<div class="rpg120-audio" id="rpg120AudioPanel" aria-label="Controles de áudio">
 <span class="rpg120-led"></span><small id="rpg120AudioStatus">Som desligado</small>
 <button type="button" id="rpg120AudioToggle" aria-pressed="false">♫ Ativar música e ambiente</button>
</div>
<script id="rpg120-audio-engine">
(()=>{'use strict';
 const panel=document.getElementById('rpg120AudioPanel'),toggle=document.getElementById('rpg120AudioToggle'),status=document.getElementById('rpg120AudioStatus');
 if(!panel||!toggle||!status)return;
 const AudioCtx=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;
 let ctx=null,master=null,musicBus=null,ambienceBus=null,sfxBus=null,enabled=false,volume=.45,stepTimer=null,step=0,voices=[],noiseSource=null;
 const chords=[[110,130.81,164.81,196],[98,123.47,146.83,185],[82.41,110,130.81,164.81],[98,123.47,155.56,196]];
 const melody=[392,440,523.25,659.25,587.33,523.25,440,392,329.63,392,440,523.25,493.88,440,392,329.63];
 function makeNoise(){const length=ctx.sampleRate*3,buffer=ctx.createBuffer(1,length,ctx.sampleRate),data=buffer.getChannelData(0);let last=0;for(let i=0;i<length;i++){last=(last+.018*(Math.random()*2-1))/.982;data[i]=last*.18}noiseSource=ctx.createBufferSource();noiseSource.buffer=buffer;noiseSource.loop=true;const low=ctx.createBiquadFilter();low.type='lowpass';low.frequency.value=520;const gain=ctx.createGain();gain.gain.value=.13;noiseSource.connect(low);low.connect(gain);gain.connect(ambienceBus);noiseSource.start()}
 function tone(freq,duration,gainValue,wave='sine',bus=musicBus){const o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();o.type=wave;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,ctx.currentTime);g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,ctx.currentTime);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(gainValue,ctx.currentTime+.22);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,ctx.currentTime+duration);o.connect(g);g.connect(bus);o.start();o.stop(ctx.currentTime+duration+.04);return o}
 function makeEngine(){if(!AudioCtx){status.textContent='Este navegador não suporta áudio';return false}if(ctx)return true;
  try{ctx=new AudioCtx();master=ctx.createGain();musicBus=ctx.createGain();ambienceBus=ctx.createGain();sfxBus=ctx.createGain();musicBus.gain.value=.62;ambienceBus.gain.value=.42;sfxBus.gain.value=.9;musicBus.connect(master);ambienceBus.connect(master);sfxBus.connect(master);master.connect(ctx.destination);master.gain.value=0;
   // Camada harmônica contínua: acordes lentos e suaves.
   const padFilter=ctx.createBiquadFilter();padFilter.type='lowpass';padFilter.frequency.value=720;padFilter.connect(musicBus);
   chords[0].forEach((f,i)=>{const o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();o.type=i===0?'triangle':'sine';o.frequency.value=f;g.gain.value=[.075,.035,.027,.018][i];o.connect(g);g.connect(padFilter);o.start();voices.push(o)});
   makeNoise();return true;
  }catch(err){status.textContent='Não foi possível iniciar o áudio';console.warn('RPG audio:',err);return false}}
 function playMusicStep(){if(!enabled||!ctx)return;const chord=chords[Math.floor(step/4)%chords.length];if(step%4===0){chord.forEach((f,i)=>tone(f,3.7,[.022,.014,.012,.009][i],'sine'));}
  const note=melody[step%melody.length];tone(note,1.55,.018,'triangle');if(step%8===4)tone(note/2,2.1,.012,'sine');step++}
 function setVolume(v){volume=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number(v)||0));if(master&&ctx&&enabled)master.gain.setTargetAtTime(volume*.42,ctx.currentTime,.16)}
 async function setEnabled(on){if(on){if(!makeEngine())return;try{if(ctx.state==='suspended')await ctx.resume();}catch(e){status.textContent='Clique novamente para liberar o som';return}
   enabled=true;master.gain.cancelScheduledValues(ctx.currentTime);master.gain.setTargetAtTime(volume*.42,ctx.currentTime,.8);if(!stepTimer){playMusicStep();stepTimer=setInterval(playMusicStep,1450)}status.textContent='Música e ambiente ligados';toggle.textContent='♫ Desativar som';panel.classList.add('on');toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');
  }else{enabled=false;if(ctx&&master){master.gain.cancelScheduledValues(ctx.currentTime);master.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,ctx.currentTime,.35)}if(stepTimer){clearInterval(stepTimer);stepTimer=null}status.textContent='Som desligado';toggle.textContent='♫ Ativar música e ambiente';panel.classList.remove('on');toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false')}
  try{localStorage.setItem('rpg120-audio',on?'on':'off')}catch(e){}}
 function effect(freq=520,duration=.12,type='sine',amount=.035){if(!enabled||!ctx||!sfxBus)return;const now=ctx.currentTime,o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,now);o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(75,freq*.62),now+duration);g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,now);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(amount,now+.012);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,now+duration);o.connect(g);g.connect(sfxBus);o.start(now);o.stop(now+duration+.02)}
 window.RPGAudioSetVolume=setVolume;window.RPGAudioEnable=()=>setEnabled(true);
 toggle.addEventListener('click',()=>setEnabled(!enabled));
 document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b||b===toggle||b.disabled)return;effect(b.matches('.rpg119-tile')?660:480,.09,'triangle',.03)},true);
 document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(!ctx||!enabled)return;if(document.hidden){ctx.suspend().catch(()=>{})}else if(enabled){ctx.resume().catch(()=>{})}});
 try{if(localStorage.getItem('rpg120-audio')==='on'){status.textContent='Clique para iniciar música + ambiente';toggle.textContent='♫ Iniciar música e ambiente'}}catch(e){}
})();
</script>


<style id="rpg121-immersion-style">
:root{--rpg121-accent:#8b5cf6;--rpg121-glow:#38bdf8}
body::before{transition:filter .8s ease,background-position 1.2s ease;filter:hue-rotate(var(--rpg121-hue,0deg)) saturate(var(--rpg121-sat,1)) brightness(var(--rpg121-bright,1))}
#rpg121AmbienceCanvas{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;opacity:.72}
#rpg121Open{position:fixed;right:16px;top:58px;z-index:1000000;border:1px solid #8b5cf6;border-radius:24px;padding:9px 13px;color:#fff;font-weight:900;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#111827ed,#4c1d95e8);box-shadow:0 0 20px #7c3aed55;cursor:pointer}
#rpg121Panel{position:fixed;right:14px;top:104px;z-index:1000001;width:min(360px,calc(100vw - 28px));max-height:min(78vh,680px);overflow:auto;padding:16px;border:1px solid #8b5cf6;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#080d1df5,#17102df5);box-shadow:0 18px 60px #000c;color:#f8fafc;display:none;backdrop-filter:blur(16px)}
#rpg121Panel.open{display:block;animation:rpg121In .22s ease-out}
@keyframes rpg121In{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-8px) scale(.98)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
#rpg121Panel h2{font-size:18px;margin:0 0 4px;color:#e9d5ff}#rpg121Panel p{font-size:12px;color:#cbd5e1;margin:0 0 12px}
.rpg121-group{padding:11px 0;border-top:1px solid #ffffff1c}.rpg121-label{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:1px;color:#a5b4fc;margin-bottom:8px;text-transform:uppercase}
.rpg121-options{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px}
.rpg121-options button,.rpg121-action{border:1px solid #64748b;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 8px;background:#111a30;color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;transition:.18s}
.rpg121-options button:hover,.rpg121-action:hover{border-color:#c4b5fd;transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 0 15px #8b5cf655}
.rpg121-options button[aria-pressed=true]{border-color:#67e8f9;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#164e63,#4c1d95);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #67e8f944}
#rpg121Panel input[type=range]{width:100%;accent-color:#a78bfa}#rpg121VolumeValue{float:right;color:#e9d5ff;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.rpg121-switch{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;color:#e2e8f0;font-size:13px;padding:5px 0}.rpg121-switch input{width:18px;height:18px;accent-color:#8b5cf6}
#rpg121Toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:22px;transform:translate(-50%,20px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:1000002;padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid #a78bfa;border-radius:30px;background:#090d1ef2;color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 8px 30px #0009;transition:.25s}
#rpg121Toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
@media(max-width:600px){#rpg121Open{top:52px;right:8px;padding:8px 10px;font-size:11px}#rpg121Panel{top:96px;right:8px;width:calc(100vw - 16px)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#rpg121Panel,#rpg121Panel *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}#rpg121AmbienceCanvas{display:none}}
</style>
<button id="rpg121Open" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="rpg121Panel">⚙️ Central de Imersão</button>
<section id="rpg121Panel" aria-label="Central de personalização">
 <h2>✦ Central de Imersão</h2><p>Personalize a atmosfera do seu mundo. As opções ficam salvas neste navegador.</p>
 <div class="rpg121-group"><span class="rpg121-label">Cenário e iluminação</span><div class="rpg121-options" id="rpg121Themes">
  <button type="button" data-theme="abyss" aria-pressed="true">🌌 Abismo</button><button type="button" data-theme="ember" aria-pressed="false">🔥 Inferno</button><button type="button" data-theme="frost" aria-pressed="false">❄️ Boreal</button><button type="button" data-theme="arcane" aria-pressed="false">🔮 Arcano</button>
 </div></div>
 <div class="rpg121-group"><span class="rpg121-label">Clima dinâmico</span><div class="rpg121-options" id="rpg121Weather">
  <button type="button" data-weather="none" aria-pressed="true">☀️ Limpo</button><button type="button" data-weather="rain" aria-pressed="false">🌧️ Chuva</button><button type="button" data-weather="snow" aria-pressed="false">❄️ Neve</button><button type="button" data-weather="embers" aria-pressed="false">🔥 Brasas</button>
 </div></div>
 <div class="rpg121-group"><span class="rpg121-label">Áudio <output id="rpg121VolumeValue">45%</output></span><input id="rpg121Volume" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="45" aria-label="Volume geral"><div class="rpg121-switch"><label for="rpg121Particles">Partículas de ambiente</label><input id="rpg121Particles" type="checkbox" checked></div><div class="rpg121-switch"><label for="rpg121Glow">Brilho mágico</label><input id="rpg121Glow" type="checkbox" checked></div></div>
 <div class="rpg121-group"><span class="rpg121-label">Conforto e desempenho</span><div class="rpg121-switch"><label for="rpg121Lite">Modo desempenho (menos efeitos)</label><input id="rpg121Lite" type="checkbox"></div><div class="rpg121-switch"><label for="rpg121Motion">Movimento reduzido</label><input id="rpg121Motion" type="checkbox"></div></div>
 <div class="rpg121-group"><button type="button" class="rpg121-action" id="rpg121Reset" style="width:100%">↺ Restaurar configurações</button></div>
</section><div id="rpg121Toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
<canvas id="rpg121AmbienceCanvas" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
<script id="rpg121-immersion-engine">
(()=>{'use strict';
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),panel=$('rpg121Panel'),open=$('rpg121Open'),canvas=$('rpg121AmbienceCanvas');if(!panel||!open||!canvas)return;
const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');if(!ctx)return;
const defaults={theme:'abyss',weather:'none',volume:45,particles:true,glow:true,lite:false,motion:false};let cfg={...defaults};try{cfg={...cfg,...JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('rpg121-settings')||'{}')}}catch(e){}
let particles=[],raf=0,last=0,toastTimer=0;
function save(){try{localStorage.setItem('rpg121-settings',JSON.stringify(cfg))}catch(e){}}
function toast(msg){const t=$('rpg121Toast');t.textContent=msg;t.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),1900)}
const themes={abyss:['0deg','1.12','1'],ember:['-48deg','1.55','1.02'],frost:['155deg','1.18','1.08'],arcane:['65deg','1.5','1.04']};
function apply(){const root=document.documentElement,theme=themes[cfg.theme]||themes.abyss;root.style.setProperty('--rpg121-hue',theme[0]);root.style.setProperty('--rpg121-sat',cfg.lite?'0.8':theme[1]);root.style.setProperty('--rpg121-bright',cfg.lite?'0.92':theme[2]);document.body.classList.toggle('rpg121-lite',cfg.lite);document.body.classList.toggle('rpg121-no-glow',!cfg.glow);document.body.classList.toggle('rpg121-reduced-motion',cfg.motion);$('rpg121Volume').value=cfg.volume;$('rpg121VolumeValue').textContent=cfg.volume+'%';$('rpg121Particles').checked=cfg.particles;$('rpg121Glow').checked=cfg.glow;$('rpg121Lite').checked=cfg.lite;$('rpg121Motion').checked=cfg.motion;document.querySelectorAll('#rpg121Themes button').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b.dataset.theme===cfg.theme)));document.querySelectorAll('#rpg121Weather button').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b.dataset.weather===cfg.weather)));if(window.RPGAudioSetVolume)window.RPGAudioSetVolume(cfg.volume/100);resetParticles();save()}
function resize(){const d=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,cfg.lite?1:1.5);canvas.width=Math.floor(innerWidth*d);canvas.height=Math.floor(innerHeight*d);canvas.style.width=innerWidth+'px';canvas.style.height=innerHeight+'px';ctx.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);resetParticles()}
function resetParticles(){const count=(!cfg.particles||cfg.lite||cfg.motion||cfg.weather==='none')?0:Math.min(130,Math.floor(innerWidth/9));particles=Array.from({length:count},()=>({x:Math.random()*innerWidth,y:Math.random()*innerHeight,s:1+Math.random()*2.5,v:.5+Math.random()*2,a:.18+Math.random()*.55,w:Math.random()*2}))}
function draw(ts){raf=requestAnimationFrame(draw);if(ts-last<(cfg.lite?55:30))return;last=ts;ctx.clearRect(0,0,innerWidth,innerHeight);if(!cfg.particles||cfg.lite||cfg.motion||cfg.weather==='none')return;for(const p of particles){p.y+=p.v*(cfg.weather==='rain'?3:1);p.x+=cfg.weather==='rain'?-1.1:Math.sin((ts/900)+p.w)*.45;if(p.y>innerHeight+10){p.y=-10;p.x=Math.random()*innerWidth}if(p.x<-10)p.x=innerWidth+10;ctx.globalAlpha=p.a;if(cfg.weather==='rain'){ctx.strokeStyle='#9bdcff';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(p.x,p.y);ctx.lineTo(p.x-3,p.y+12*p.s);ctx.stroke()}else{ctx.fillStyle=cfg.weather==='snow'?'#e0f2fe':cfg.weather==='embers'?'#fb923c':'#c4b5fd';ctx.shadowBlur=cfg.glow?9:0;ctx.shadowColor=ctx.fillStyle;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.s,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}}ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.shadowBlur=0}
open.addEventListener('click',()=>{const on=panel.classList.toggle('open');open.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(on));if(on)toast('Central de Imersão aberta')});
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(!panel.contains(e.target)&&e.target!==open&&!open.contains(e.target)){panel.classList.remove('open');open.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false')}});
$('rpg121Themes').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button[data-theme]');if(!b)return;cfg.theme=b.dataset.theme;apply();toast('Cenário: '+b.textContent.trim())});
$('rpg121Weather').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button[data-weather]');if(!b)return;cfg.weather=b.dataset.weather;apply();toast('Clima atualizado: '+b.textContent.trim())});
$('rpg121Volume').addEventListener('input',e=>{cfg.volume=Number(e.target.value);$('rpg121VolumeValue').textContent=cfg.volume+'%';if(window.RPGAudioSetVolume)window.RPGAudioSetVolume(cfg.volume/100);save()});
[['rpg121Particles','particles'],['rpg121Glow','glow'],['rpg121Lite','lite'],['rpg121Motion','motion']].forEach(([id,key])=>$(id).addEventListener('change',e=>{cfg[key]=e.target.checked;apply();toast('Preferência atualizada')}));
$('rpg121Reset').addEventListener('click',()=>{cfg={...defaults};apply();toast('Configurações restauradas')});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'){panel.classList.remove('open');open.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false')}if((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)&&e.key.toLowerCase()==='m'){e.preventDefault();$('rpg120AudioToggle')?.click()}});
addEventListener('resize',resize,{passive:true});resize();apply();cancelAnimationFrame(raf);raf=requestAnimationFrame(draw);
})();
</script>


<style id="rpg123-living-background-style">
body::before{background-size:cover,cover!important;background-position:center,center!important;animation:rpg123-drift var(--rpg123-speed,42s) ease-in-out infinite alternate!important;transition:filter 1.4s ease,background-image 1.2s ease,opacity 1s ease!important;will-change:transform,filter}
@keyframes rpg123-drift{0%{transform:scale(1.04) translate3d(-.7%,.2%,0);background-position:center,48% 50%}50%{transform:scale(1.10) translate3d(.4%,-.5%,0);background-position:center,53% 48%}100%{transform:scale(1.06) translate3d(.8%,.3%,0);background-position:center,56% 52%}}
body.rpg123-rain::before{filter:brightness(.58) saturate(.78) hue-rotate(7deg)!important}
body.rpg123-snow::before{filter:brightness(.78) saturate(.62) hue-rotate(165deg)!important}
body.rpg123-embers::before{filter:brightness(.72) saturate(1.55) sepia(.25)!important}
body.rpg123-mist::before{filter:brightness(.66) saturate(.65) blur(1px)!important}
body.rpg123-storm::before{filter:brightness(.48) saturate(.85) contrast(1.18)!important;animation-duration:19s!important}
body.rpg123-clear::before{filter:brightness(.92) saturate(1.05)!important}
#rpg123WeatherFlash{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 75% 12%,#dbeafe88,transparent 48%);mix-blend-mode:screen}
body.rpg123-storm #rpg123WeatherFlash{animation:rpg123-lightning 11s infinite}
@keyframes rpg123-lightning{0%,91%,93%,100%{opacity:0}91.3%,92%{opacity:.26}92.3%{opacity:.04}}
body.rpg123-rain::after,body.rpg123-snow::after,body.rpg123-embers::after,body.rpg123-mist::after,body.rpg123-storm::after{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;opacity:.16}
body.rpg123-rain::after{background:linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 35%,#93c5fd22 50%,transparent 65%)}
body.rpg123-snow::after{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%,#dbeafe25,transparent 70%)}
body.rpg123-embers::after{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 100%,#f9731625,transparent 65%)}
body.rpg123-mist::after{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#cbd5e122,transparent 55%,#94a3b822)}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){body::before{animation:none!important}body.rpg123-storm #rpg123WeatherFlash{animation:none!important}}
</style>
<script id="rpg123-living-background-engine">
(()=>{'use strict';
const body=document.body,weatherBox=document.getElementById('rpg121Weather');if(!weatherBox)return;
const gallery=[...document.querySelectorAll('.rpg118-gallery img')].map(i=>i.currentSrc||i.src).filter(Boolean);
const art={abyss:gallery[0],ember:gallery[1]||gallery[0],frost:gallery[2]||gallery[0],arcane:gallery[3]||gallery[0]};
const weatherNames={none:'Céu limpo',rain:'Chuva',snow:'Neve',embers:'Brasas',mist:'Névoa',storm:'Tempestade'};
let flash=document.getElementById('rpg123WeatherFlash');if(!flash){flash=document.createElement('div');flash.id='rpg123WeatherFlash';body.appendChild(flash)}
function current(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('rpg121-settings')||'{}')}catch(e){return {}}}
function setLiving(){const c=current(),theme=art[c.theme]||art.abyss,w=c.weather||'none';const overlays={none:'linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(2,5,16,.54),rgba(2,5,16,.72))',rain:'linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(3,13,31,.68),rgba(2,8,22,.82))',snow:'linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(9,23,43,.53),rgba(4,12,27,.78))',embers:'linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(32,12,7,.58),rgba(14,5,8,.82))',mist:'linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(21,29,43,.72),rgba(9,15,29,.83))',storm:'linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(1,4,17,.78),rgba(3,7,22,.88))'};
if(theme){document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--rpg123-image',`url("${theme}")`);const css=`${overlays[w]||overlays.none},url("${theme}")`;body.style.setProperty('--rpg123-bg',css);const style=document.getElementById('rpg123-bg-runtime')||document.head.appendChild(Object.assign(document.createElement('style'),{id:'rpg123-bg-runtime'}));style.textContent=`body::before{background-image:${css}!important}`}
body.classList.remove('rpg123-rain','rpg123-snow','rpg123-embers','rpg123-mist','rpg123-storm','rpg123-clear');if(w!=='none')body.classList.add('rpg123-'+w);else body.classList.add('rpg123-clear');body.style.setProperty('--rpg123-speed',w==='storm'?'19s':w==='rain'?'27s':w==='snow'?'48s':'42s');
let label=document.getElementById('rpg123ClimateLabel');if(!label){label=document.createElement('div');label.id='rpg123ClimateLabel';label.style.cssText='position:fixed;left:14px;bottom:14px;z-index:999998;padding:7px 11px;border:1px solid #a78bfa66;border-radius:20px;background:#050817b8;color:#e2e8f0;font:800 11px Arial;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .5s';body.appendChild(label)}label.textContent='🌌 '+(weatherNames[w]||weatherNames.none)+' · '+({abyss:'Abismo',ember:'Inferno',frost:'Boreal',arcane:'Arcano'}[c.theme]||'Abismo');
}
// Add climate presets while preserving the original settings and click handler.
if(!weatherBox.querySelector('[data-weather="mist"]')){const extras=[['mist','🌫️ Névoa'],['storm','⛈️ Tempestade']];extras.forEach(([v,t])=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.dataset.weather=v;b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');b.textContent=t;weatherBox.appendChild(b)})}
weatherBox.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.closest('button[data-weather]'))setTimeout(setLiving,0)});
document.getElementById('rpg121Themes')?.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.closest('button[data-theme]'))setTimeout(setLiving,0)});
document.getElementById('rpg121Reset')?.addEventListener('click',()=>setTimeout(setLiving,0));
setLiving();
})();
</script>


<style id="rpg124-layout-fix">
/* Corrige os atalhos que cobriam o mapa e os cards em telas pequenas. */
#r115Btn,#r101BossBtn,#rpg11Btn{position:static!important;inset:auto!important;right:auto!important;bottom:auto!important;top:auto!important;margin:0!important;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}
#rpg124Dock{position:fixed;right:14px;bottom:14px;z-index:100002;width:min(270px,calc(100vw - 28px));font-family:inherit}
#rpg124Dock[hidden]{display:none!important}
#rpg124DockToggle{width:100%;padding:13px 16px;border:1px solid #c4a6ff88;border-radius:16px;color:#fff;font-weight:950;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#111827f2,#4c1d95f2);box-shadow:0 12px 38px #000b;cursor:pointer}
#rpg124DockPanel{display:none;gap:8px;margin-bottom:9px;padding:10px;border:1px solid #8b5cf688;border-radius:18px;background:#071020f2;backdrop-filter:blur(16px);box-shadow:0 18px 50px #000c}
#rpg124Dock.open #rpg124DockPanel{display:grid}
#rpg124DockPanel button{min-height:43px;text-align:left;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:11px;font-weight:900}
#r115Overlay{z-index:100010!important;padding:clamp(8px,2vw,22px)!important}
.r115-shell{width:min(1160px,100%)!important;box-sizing:border-box;margin:8px auto!important;max-height:calc(100dvh - 16px);overflow:auto}
#r115Content{min-width:0}
.r115-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,260px),1fr))!important}
.r116-card{min-width:0}
.r116-card p{line-height:1.55}
.r115-tabs{position:sticky;top:-1px;z-index:3;padding:8px 0;background:#101827f5}
.r115-tabs button{flex:1 1 auto}
@media(max-width:600px){
 .r115-head{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}
 .r115-shell{padding:13px!important}
 .r115-tabs button{font-size:11px;padding:9px 8px}
 #rpg124Dock{right:9px;bottom:9px;width:min(230px,calc(100vw - 18px))}
}
</style>

 </div>
